subject: Leadership hiring sign-off: Q3 headcount & compensation alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Team <leadership@redwood.com>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership hiring sign-off: Q3 headcount & compensation alignment

Team —

Attached is the consolidated Q3 headcount plan (tabbed by org) and the proposed leadership comp-band adjustments. This is the version I discussed with HR and Finance last week; changes are highlighted in yellow. Key asks: 

- Can leadership review and sign off on the additions to the executive headcount slate (pages 1–3)? These are time-sensitive because offers will go out the week of 6/15.
- Finance (Marcus): confirm that the annualized run-rate in tab "Budgeted Opex" aligns with the Q3 forecast we took to the board.
- Eng (Vivek): confirm the seniority/band for the two director hires so we can finalize offer packages.
- Talent (Tessa, Stephanie): confirm recruiting capacity and external agency usage (Rebecca Chen on copy can assist).

I’ve also included a PDF with the recommended comp-band harmonization for leadership roles; small upward shifts in midpoints where market data warrants. If we can get sign-offs by EOD 6/10 we can commit to the candidate timelines without asking for approvals to stretch offers.

Attachments: Q3_HC_plan_v3.xlsx (master), Comp_Bands_Leadership.pdf

—
Marissa Cole
VP, People & Programs
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership hiring sign-off: Q3 headcount & compensation alignment

Marissa —

Thanks for the doc. A few quick questions from Eng: 

1) Director, Model Ops (headcount request #12): the sheet lists "D3" as target band. Given scope (multi-region infra + Dedicated onboarding), I think this should be D4. Moving would change offer comp ~+12% and pulling from discretionary. Can we discuss trade-offs?

2) For the two lead hires on the product side, are we comfortable offering sign-on equity in lieu of base to stay within the band? That would require exec approval for an exception to the standard comp-for-equity ratio.

If we can get Marcus' read on the P&L impact (annualized) I can confirm whether the headcount timing can be pushed by 3 weeks without impacting Q3 deliverables.

Thanks,
Vivek

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership hiring sign-off: Q3 headcount & compensation alignment

Marissa/Vivek —

Reviewed the "Budgeted Opex" tab. Short answer: the plan is affordable within the board-approved headcount envelope IF we hold salary midpoints as proposed. If we move the Model Ops role to D4 (Vivek's suggestion) and increase the two product leads with sign-on equity, we will exceed the Q3 cash run-rate by ~7% unless we reallocate two open IC positions (chart in cell G42).

Options: 
- Approve as-is (maintain bands) and prioritize internal reallocation (faster, no cash impact).
- Approve band uplift for Model Ops and offset with a hiring freeze on two senior ICs for one quarter.
- Approve increased comp with approval from CEO for a one-time Opex adjustment (requires justification).

I can run a sensitivity and produce a short memo for the CFO by EOD 6/11 if that helps for exec sign-off.

Marcus
Director, FP&A
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Rebecca Chen <rebecca@talentpartners.co>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership hiring sign-off: Q3 headcount & compensation alignment

Thanks for the fast turn. Short replies inline: 

- Vivek: okay to move Model Ops to D4 given scope. We will require a 1-yr commitment for cross-regional rollout milestones written into the offer letter (standard practice for senior hires) to protect runway.

- On sign-on equity: I prefer a blended approach (smaller base uplift + one-time equity signing grant) rather than pushing all comp into equity. That keeps total cash footprint lower while remaining competitive. I'll draft the exception memo template for CEO review.

- Marcus: please run the sensitivity and send the CFO memo; highlight the offset options so the CEO can choose instead of blocking all hires.

Tessa/Stephanie/Rebecca — please confirm the recruiting timeline (agency vs internal) and the proposed candidate-facing offer cadence (first offers week of 6/15, second wave week of 7/6). If recruiting capacity is constrained, call that out — we may need to stagger.

Attachment: Offer_Templates.zip (email templates + standard signability clauses)

—
Marissa

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Rebecca Chen <rebecca@talentpartners.co>, Joan Park <joan.park@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership hiring sign-off: Q3 headcount & compensation alignment

All —

Recruiting confirms we can meet the proposed cadence with a blended approach: internal lead + Talent Partners supporting the two senior searches (Director Model Ops and Sr Product Lead). Rebecca has the candidate pipelines ready; Joan from Acme (external bench) is cc'd to acknowledge resource sharing on background checks.

We will: 
- Push the first set of offers 6/15 (Director Model Ops at D4; Sr Product Lead at band P3 with blended equity).
- Hold off on the two lower-priority IC hires until 7/1 to free up budget headroom (per Marcus’ sensitivity options).

Next steps: Marcus to send CFO sensitivity memo by EOD 6/11; Marissa to circulate final sign-off doc (short approval checkbox) once memo is in. If no flag by 6/11 EOD, recruiting will proceed to prepare offers.

—
Tessa Morgan
Head of Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
